en: The treasure's ours! That makes two!
A job well done. Now we just have to{SAUT}deliver them.
Ohoho! A resounding success for{SAUT}Masked Avenger Teddie!
Wha―!? Not so loud!{PAGE}Look, we're not done yet. A phantom{SAUT}thief isn't finished until they make it{SAUT}back to their hideout.
Wow, sounds just like a field trip.
A field trip where we could get{SAUT}eaten by dinosaurs...{PAGE}Well, I'm glad everything went well.{SAUT}Not bad for some first-time phantom{SAUT}thieves, huh?
Good job, guys! Come on back!
